i01.name: Bibimbap (Mixed Rice Bowl)
i01.short: Rice with seasoned vegetables, egg and chili paste
i01.detail: Warm rice topped with bean sprouts, spinach, bracken and an egg, served with gochujang chili paste and sesame oil. One bowl is a full meal for one.
